claim: Patchline infers the privacy impact of migrations that delete, export, anonymize, or change the retention of personal data, so that a change touching PII is labeled with its data-protection consequence rather than treated as an ordinary schema edit. The worker joins each operation against a PII classification of the affected column and assigns a privacy impact: exports of PII are high, deletes are erasure-relevant, anonymization is mitigating, retention-policy changes are relevant, and operations on non-PII columns carry no privacy impact. The gate proves a PII export is high impact, a PII delete is erasure-relevant, a PII anonymization is mitigating, a PII retention change is relevant, and a non-PII operation has no privacy impact.
real_repo: synthetic-from-real patterns: GDPR/CCPA-style deletes, exports, anonymization, retention
